facts.title: Learn Blacksmithing
facts.location: Smith Argus, Goldshire, across from the inn
facts.note: No level requirement in Forever. Buy a Blacksmith Hammer from Tharynn Bouden in Goldshire; most recipes need it.

facts.title: Learn Blacksmithing
facts.location: Dwukk, at the forge in Razor Hill
facts.note: No level requirement in Forever. Buy a Blacksmith Hammer from Flakk in Razor Hill; most recipes need it.

facts.title: Blacksmithing 1-75: stones, then Runed Copper Gauntlets
facts.note: 1-25: 30 Rough Sharpening Stone. 25-50: 30 Rough Grinding Stone (keep 26). 50-67: 36 Coarse Grinding Stone (keep them for 95). 67-75: 8 Runed Copper Gauntlets (64 Copper Bar, 16 Rough Grinding Stone).

facts.title: Journeyman Blacksmithing
facts.note: Needs Blacksmithing 50 and level 10. Traugh at the Crossroads also teaches Journeyman.

facts.title: Blacksmithing 75-150: bronze
facts.note: 75-80 Runed Copper Belt (or Silver Rod); 80-95 Rough Bronze Leggings; 95-100 Patterned Bronze Bracers; 100-112 Heavy Grinding Stone; 112-125 the bracers again; 125-140 Bronze Shortsword; 140-150 Bronze Warhammer. Weak and Strong Flux are sold by the Blacksmithing Supply vendor beside each capital city trainer.

facts.title: Expert Blacksmithing
facts.location: Saru Steelfury, Valley of Honor, Orgrimmar
facts.note: Needs Blacksmithing 125 and level 20; 50 silver. He is the only Horde Expert trainer listed.

facts.title: Expert Blacksmithing is in Ironforge
facts.location: Bengus Deepforge, the Great Forge, Ironforge
facts.note: Needs Blacksmithing 125 and level 20; 50 silver. Alard Schmied in Dalaran is also listed, but the trainer page says he may be bugged in the beta.
